title: The Cicones
setup: Your first stop after Troy is Ismarus, the city of the Cicones. You and the crew have sacked the city and divided the treasure. Odysseus tells everyone to leave right away, but there is still wine to drink and sheep and cattle to feast on along the shore.

choices.text: Stay on the beach and feast

title: The Lotus-Eaters
setup: After nine days blown off course by storms, your ship reaches the land of the Lotus-Eaters. Odysseus sends you and two other men ahead to find out who lives there. The people are friendly, and they offer you the lotus to eat.

choices.text: Refuse the lotus and report back to the ship

title: Polyphemus
imageCredit: Arnold Böcklin, Odysseus and Polyphemus (1896), Museum of Fine Arts, Boston
setup: You are Odysseus. You blinded the Cyclops Polyphemus and escaped his cave by hiding your men under his sheep, and he still thinks your name is Nobody. Now your ship is pulling away from the shore, and he is raging on the cliffs.

choices.text: Shout your real name at Polyphemus

title: The Cattle of Helios
setup: Your ship is stranded on Thrinacia, the island where the sun god Helios keeps his cattle. The winds have you trapped here for a month and the food is gone. Circe and Tiresias have both warned you that eating the cattle will curse you and your crew.

choices.text: Respect the gods and potentially starve
Eat the cattle to survive, but break your oath

title: Calypso's Offer
setup: You are Odysseus. After the shipwreck you washed up on the island of the goddess Calypso, and you have been there for seven years. The gods have ordered her to let you go home, but she tells you that if you stay with her, she will make you immortal and ageless.

choices.text: Leave for Ithaca and stay mortal
Stay with Calypso and become immortal

title: Return to Ithaca
imageCredit: Claude Lorrain, The Embarkation of Ulysses (1646), Musée du Louvre, Paris
setup: You are Odysseus, home at last after twenty years. Athena has disguised you as an old beggar, and the suitors who want to marry your wife are feasting in your hall. When you ask them for food, the suitor Antinous insults you and throws a footstool at you.

choices.text: Endure it and keep your disguise
Fight back and reveal who you are
